description: A decorative hand mirror with an ornate, spiky frame. The mirror's surface reflects a stylized crown with pointed tips and a band of small diamonds. The frame itself features sharp, angular protrusions around its perimeter, adding a gothic or fantasy element. The handle is also elongated and tapers to a pointed end, echoing the sharp aesthetic of the frame. The overall design suggests a magical or ceremonial object, possibly associated with royalty or dark fantasy themes. The monochromatic sketch style emphasizes the intricate linework and silhouette.
